title: Costa Resiliente STAC Catalog
description: Geospatial data catalog for Lima Metropolitana flood/huayco awareness. Includes Sentinel-1 GRD scenes, IMERG rasters, and derived flood polygons.

collections.title: Sentinel-1 GRD — Lima Metropolitana
collections.description: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR GRD scenes clipped to Lima AOI, sourced from Microsoft Planetary Computer.

collections.title: NASA IMERG Early Run — Lima Watersheds
collections.description: Half-hourly IMERG precipitation rasters and watershed accumulation summaries.

collections.title: SAR-derived Flood Polygons
collections.description: ML flood segmentation output polygons per Sentinel-1 acquisition.
